subject: english
stem: Ben thought cooking was only following steps. After tasting a bland soup, he learned to adjust seasoning little by little. How does his understanding change?
options: He decides recipes have no value at all.
He loses the ability to taste.
He believes more salt is always better.
He sees cooking as requiring judgment as well as steps.

optionRationales.reason: He decides recipes have no value at all.：不是完全否定步驟。
He loses the ability to taste.：與 tasting 相反。
He believes more salt is always better.：little by little 不支持 always。
He sees cooking as requiring judgment as well as steps.：由機械照步驟到依味道調整。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「故事開頭與結尾在能力、態度、信念或行動上的對照顯示人物變化」可推出 He sees cooking as requiring judgment as well as steps.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 He sees cooking as requiring judgment as well as steps. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
